en: The Questions of King Milinda, Chapter on the Determination of Formless Phenomena: 11.
The Question on the Cessation of In-breathing and Out-breathing
"Venerable Nāgasena, do you say that it is possible to stop the inhalation and exhalation?"
“Yes, Great King, it is possible to stop the inhalation and exhalation.
“But how, venerable Nāgasena, is it possible to stop the inhalation and exhalation?
“What do you think, Great King? Have you ever heard of anyone who was gasping for breath?”
“Yes, venerable sir, I have heard it before.
“But, great king, would that sound cease when the body was bent?

“Indeed, Great King, if even the sound would cease when the body is bent down by one who has not developed the body, has not developed virtue, has not developed the mind, and has not developed wisdom,
how much more so will the in-breaths and out-breaths cease for one who has developed the body, developed virtue, developed the mind, and developed wisdom, and who has attained the fourth jhāna?”
This concludes the eleventh chapter, the Chapter on the Cessation of Inhalation and Exhalation.
